vulnerability_analysis: The _userTransfer() function incorrectly handles burn tokens. It calculates burn amount (2% of transfer) and adds it to totalBurn, but doesn't actually burn tokens by decreasing totalSupply or sending to address(0). Instead, it deducts the full amount from sender but only transfers (amount - burn - term - bouns) to recipient. This creates an accounting mismatch where totalSupply remains unchanged but totalBurn increases. The contract's _getMarketTotalToken() function subtracts totalBurn from totalSupply when calculating market tokens, but since totalSupply doesn't actually decrease, this creates an inconsistency that can be exploited.
attack_strategy: Create two controlled accounts (attacker and helper). Transfer tokens between them repeatedly. Each transfer will: 1) Deduct full amount from sender, 2) Add only (amount - fees) to recipient, 3) Increase totalBurn without reducing totalSupply. After many transfers, the sum of balances in our controlled accounts will be greater than expected due to the missing burn deduction from totalSupply. We can then extract profit by transferring tokens out.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Ensure attacker is not admin (adminAddress[attacker] = false). 2. Get initial LoveDoge tokens using deal(). 3. Create a helper address. 4. Transfer tokens from attacker to helper (triggering _userTransfer). 5. Transfer back from helper to attacker. 6. Repeat many times to accumulate the accounting error. 7. Verify attacker's balance increased.
